methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly via WebFetch for each vendor: trainerize.com/pricing, truecoach.co/pricing, everfit.io/pricing, ptdistinction.com/pricing, mypthub.net/pricing, fitbudd.com/pricing, and kahunas.io. Trainerize's official page renders only Free, Grow, Pro 5, and Studio Plus prices prominently; the intermediate Pro 15-Pro 200 and Studio Max tiers DO exist (client-capacity tiers confirmed on the official page) and their dollar amounts were corroborated against TWO independent third parties (quickcoach.fit and coachingportal.io), which agree exactly. The draft's claim of a 'March 2026 update raising Pro 5 from $23 to $25' is unsupported: the official page shows $23, which is restored. Everfit Pro 50-client price was corrected from $120/$100 to the official $95 monthly / $79 annual. FitBudd Elite tiers carry a $100 one-time setup fee per the official page (draft had $0). Where annual plans use 'N months free' (TrueCoach), the annual-equivalent monthly rate was computed as monthly x (12 - free months) / 12. My PT Hub publishes EUR only; USD set to null. No vendor or plan was fabricated; none removed. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

Pro 15-Pro 200 and Studio Max dollar amounts corroborated against two independent third parties (quickcoach.fit and coachingportal.io), which agree exactly.
